description: A path-traversal finding injected into a templated path segment. There is no named parameter, so this fixture pins the EMPTY param_name case, and it observes the defect by a stack trace in the response body rather than by reflection.

not_hashed.response_body_sha256: referenced, never inlined - plan/00-SPINE.md S7 names the DAST response body the highest-risk field

mutations.name: http_method_lowercased
mutations.description: Method case does not fork identity.

mutations.name: route_template_carrying_the_traversal_payload_as_a_query_string
mutations.description: The payload smuggled into the template is dropped with the rest of the query string.

mutations.name: route_template_in_flask_placeholder_syntax
mutations.description: Flask and Werkzeug spell a variable segment '<path:filename>'. It normalises to the same <VAR> as '{path}' and ':path'.

mutations.name: route_template_already_carrying_the_canonical_placeholder_token
mutations.description: Idempotence: feeding a canonicalised route back through CanonicalRouteTemplate must be a fixed point, or a record round-tripped through the store would fork its own identity.

notes: An empty param_name is legal and is hashed as an empty field, keeping the DAST field count at exactly eight. A whole-body, raw-request, or path-segment injection has no single named parameter, and rejecting those would make them unfingerprintable.

DIGEST CHANGED 2026-08-08 under the R.3 blocker-2 ruling, from 84fe311debbc87f852e1f4e17a3242d071169448c5852a00b1b32316fb30b036. The hashed route_template moved from '/files/{path}' to '/files/<VAR>' because CanonicalRouteTemplate now normalises an already-templated segment onto the one frozen placeholder token rather than trusting the producer's choice of syntax. Nothing was stored under the old digest - anvil-fp/v1 has not shipped. See internal/record/FINGERPRINT-SPEC.md section 6.

The input's '{path}' was the ONLY normalization the old corpus exercised on this field, and it exercised it by arriving pre-templated - which is exactly why CRITIQUE-01 could not detect that CanonicalRouteTemplate did no templating at all. dast-04 is the fixture that closes that hole, with a concrete numeric id and a concrete UUID.
